1. Free Fatty acid content of the ghee should be less than 0.5%, more than 3% is considered

11. Iodine value (indicator for saturated fat) is also in the acceptable range, Animal fats are

15. Saponification value (NDDB CALF Sr.No #47) is slightly higher
17. Report shows 241 but the range is 205-235

The whole confusion is coming from Annexure 1

S-Value and equations

There are 5 equations : 3 of them showing the samples are OK and other

two equations are showing around 20

If the S value of 20 is correct, there is no justification in NDDB CALF report

Stearic acid levels are in good shape, iodine value is in the good range and

free fatty acids are below 0.5%

NDDB CALF report showing S-value and Annexure 1 values are confusing.

NDDB CALF Sr. No 13 Lauric acid levels are quite high

Lauric acid is 11.71 (the range is 1.5-4.0)

It is definitely coming from usage of coconut oil

Coconut oil contains high levels of lauric acid

BASED ON THE REPORT THE PRODUCT IS ADULTERATED WITH VEGETABLE OILS NOT WITH ANIMAL FATS
